test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Bhavna saw him carrying your suitcase.

options.text: Your suitcase carried by him was seen by Bhavna.
He was seen by Bhavna carrying your suitcase.
He had been seen by Bhavna carrying your suitcase.
Your suitcase was seen by Bhavna carrying him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the **active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.**
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is:** "Bhavna saw him carrying your suitcase."**
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object** "him" at** the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form** "saw" to "was seen" **(simple past passive).
 
• Add the preposition** "by"** followed by the original subject **"Bhavna."**
 
• Keep the gerund phrase** "carrying your suitcase"** at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"He was seen by Bhavna carrying your suitcase."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Your suitcase carried by him was seen by Bhavna." – Incorrect word order and meaning.
 
• **Option 3:** "He had been seen by Bhavna carrying your suitcase." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4:** "Your suitcase was seen by Bhavna carrying him." – Incorrect meaning and structure.
